description: Uninstall an extension from the company. Takes the `extensionId` from get_installed_extensions, never a name. CONFIRM WITH THE MERCHANT BEFORE CALLING, naming the extension: the install record is deleted for good — there is NO undo from here, and re-installing does not bring the extension’s own settings back. It also removes what the extension added to the cabinet (its menu entries and detail-page blocks disappear for every user) and runs the extension’s own teardown: WooCommerce stops syncing the store, Vendara and Zapier are disabled, TIMEmSYSTEM’s settings are deleted, Custom Payment queues a final invoice for the transactions already processed. Orders, products and customers that came in through the extension are NOT deleted. If the merchant only wants to stop using it for a while, tell them there is no pause — uninstall is the only option.

extensionId.description: extensionId from get_installed_extensions — not a name
